source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice long questions written from Chapter 15 (PDF 45-60), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 15 (Physical Optics) ke poore chapter se practice long questions (tafseeli sawal) hain, Board ke long question ki shakal mein: har 5 number ke theory sawal (definition, wazahat, derivation) ke baad usi mauzu ka 3 number ka numerical hai. Har sawal ka model jawab hai; numericals qadam ba qadam hal kiye gaye hain.

blocks.prompt:
1 What is a wavefront? Describe its types. State Huygens' principle and explain how it is used to find the new position of a wavefront. (5 marks)
(Wavefront kya hai? Is ki qismein bayan karein. Huygens ka usool bayan karein aur wazahat karein ke is se wavefront ki nayi jagah kaise maloom ki jati hai.)
blocks.explanation:
Wavefront: aik khayali satah jo un tamam points ko jorti hai jahan lehron ka phase aik jaisa ho. Lagataar wavefronts ka kam se kam faasla wavelength hai, aur energy wavefront par amood (perpendicular) chalti hai. Wavefront par amood line jo chalne ki simt dikhaye ray (shua) hai.

Qismein:
(1) Plane wavefronts: seedhi lakeerein, maslan door ke sitaron ki light, ripple tank ke seedhe vibrator ki lehrein.
(2) Circular wavefronts: maslan talab ke paani ki lehrein (do jihaton mein point source).
(3) Spherical wavefronts: teen-jihati jagah mein awaz ya light ka point source. Bohat door (zameen par sooraj ki light) yeh plane maane ja sakte hain. Lens ke focal point par point source doosri taraf plane wavefronts deta hai.

Huygens ka usool: Wavefront ka har point secondary wavelets ka source hai jo lehar ki speed se har taraf phailte hain. Baad ke waqt ka naya wavefront in wavelets ko chhoone wali satah (envelope) hai.

Banawat (Fig. 15.2): AB aik wavefront hai jo source se bahar chal raha hai. Speed v har jagah aik jaisi maanein. t waqt mein wavefront vt faasla chalta hai. AB par markaz rakh kar vt radius ke kai daire (wavelets) banayein. In ka envelope, curve CD, naya wavefront hai.

Huygens ke sab nataij Maxwell's equations se bhi milte hain, magar Huygens ka model asaan hai.

book_ref.quote: Huygens assumed that every point of a wavefront may be considered the source of secondary wavelets

blocks.prompt:
2 A spherical wavefront of radius 1.5 m spreads from a point source in a medium where light travels at 2.0 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹. Using Huygens' construction, find (i) the radius of the wavelets for a time of 2.5 ns, (ii) the radius of the new wavefront, (iii) the number of wavefronts, one wavelength apart, between the old and new positions if the wavelength in the medium is 400 nm. (3 marks)
(Aik point source se 1.5 m radius ka spherical wavefront aise medium mein phail raha hai jahan light 2.0 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹ se chalti hai. Huygens ki banawat se nikalein: (i) 2.5 ns ke liye wavelets ka radius, (ii) naye wavefront ka radius, (iii) agar medium mein wavelength 400 nm ho to purani aur nayi jagah ke darmiyan kitne wavefronts (aik wavelength ke faasle par) hain.)
blocks.explanation: Wavelets ka radius vt hai; naya wavefront envelope hai jo vt aage barhta hai; wavefronts aik wavelength door hain.

book_ref.quote: Then in time t the wavefront travels a distance vt.

blocks.prompt:
3 What is interference of waves? Explain constructive and destructive interference using the principle of superposition. What are coherent sources, and what are the basic conditions for interference? (5 marks)
(Lehron ka interference kya hai? Superposition ke usool se constructive aur destructive interference ki wazahat karein. Coherent sources kya hain, aur interference ki bunyadi sharait kya hain?)
blocks.explanation:
Interference: Do coherent lehrein kisi ilaqe mein mil kar kuch points par aik doosre ko mazboot aur kuch par khatam karti hain; is pattern ko interference (madakhilat) kehte hain. Yeh superposition ke usool se samjha jata hai.

Misal: aik hi source se jure do loudspeakers aik jaisi frequency aur wavelength ki awaz in phase nikalte hain.
Constructive interference: kuch points par dono lehrein in phase aur barabar amplitude ke saath pohnchti hain; resultant amplitude dugna aur awaz tez (Fig. 15.3 a). Mukhtalif amplitudes bhi constructive interference karti hain (Fig. 15.3 c).
Destructive interference: jahan lehrein barabar amplitude ke saath antiphase mein pohnchein wahan khatam ho jati hain aur resultant sifar (Fig. 15.3 b); khamosh jagah.

Coherent sources: aise sources jin ki lehron ka phase difference mustaqil ho. Yeh sirf tab mumkin hai jab frequency aik jaisi aur mustaqil ho. Thori mukhtalif frequency wale alag generators par do loudspeakers in aur out of phase hote hain (tez, halka, tez) aur pattern badalta hai. Aik hi generator par woh coherent hain. Light ke liye aik laser ki light do slits se taqseem kar ke do coherent sources bante hain; ghair-coherent sources sirf yaksaan roshni ki patti dete hain.

Bunyadi sharait:
(1) Lehrein aik hi qisam ki hon (awaz sirf awaz ke saath).
(2) Lehrein coherent hon (mustaqil phase difference).
(3) Lehrein aik hi ya taqreeban aik hi simt mein chalein.
Mukhtalif amplitudes bhi interference karti hain magar pattern ka contrast kam ho jata hai.

book_ref.quote: The basic conditions for two waves to produce interference are

blocks.prompt:
4 Two loudspeakers connected to the same signal generator emit sound of wavelength 0.50 m in phase. Point P is 3.25 m from one speaker and 4.00 m from the other; point Q is 2.00 m and 3.00 m from them. Find the path difference at each point and state whether the sound there is loud or quiet. (3 marks)
(Aik hi signal generator se jure do loudspeakers 0.50 m wavelength ki awaz in phase nikalte hain. Point P aik speaker se 3.25 m aur doosre se 4.00 m door hai; point Q 2.00 m aur 3.00 m door hai. Har point par path difference nikalein aur batayein ke awaz tez hai ya halki.)
blocks.explanation: Path difference ko λ se taqseem karein: poora adad yani in phase (tez); aadha adad yani antiphase (halki).

book_ref.quote: Consider two loudspeakers producing sounds of same frequency and wavelength.

steps: 1.5λ aadhe-adad wavelengths hain: destructive interference, P par halki awaz
Q par: path difference = 3.00 − 2.00 = 1.00 m = 2λ, poora adad: constructive interference, Q par tez awaz
blocks.final_answer: P: 1.5λ, halki awaz (destructive); Q: 2λ, tez awaz (constructive)

blocks.prompt:
5 Describe an experiment to show interference of microwaves. How are regions of high and low intensity detected, and what decides whether a point has high or low intensity? (5 marks)
(Microwaves ka interference dikhane ka tajurba bayan karein. Zyada aur kam intensity ki jagahein kaise pakri jati hain, aur kya tay karta hai ke kisi point par intensity zyada hogi ya kam?)
blocks.explanation:
Saaz-o-saman (Fig. 15.6): 2.8 cm wavelength ka microwave saaz, do gaps wali metal ki deewar, aur probe receiver.

Tareeqa: Microwave transmitter ko deewar ke do gaps ki taraf rakha jata hai. Microwaves dono gaps par diffract ho kar aage phailti aur aapas mein milti hain. Aik hi transmitter se roshan dono gaps do coherent sources ka kaam karte hain.

Pakarna: Probe receiver ko deewar ke aage hilaya jata hai. Yeh zyada intensity (constructive interference) aur kam intensity (destructive interference) ki jagahein dhoondta hai. Probe ko meter, ya audio amplifier aur loudspeaker se jora ja sakta hai taake awaz sunai de.

Shart: Agar do gaps se probe tak path difference poore wavelengths, mλ, ho to lehrein in phase pohnchti hain aur intensity zyada. Agar aadhe-adad, (m + ½)λ, ho to antiphase aur intensity kam.

Is se pata chalta hai ke interference har lehar ki khasiyat hai; do loudspeakers mein tez aur halki awaz, aur light mein roshan aur andheri fringes isi tarah banti hain.

book_ref.quote: The microwaves are diffracted at the two gaps so that they spread out into the region beyond

blocks.prompt:
6 In the 2.8 cm microwave experiment, the probe is 56.0 cm from one gap and 64.4 cm from the other. (i) Is the intensity high or low? (ii) The probe is moved so that its distance from the farther gap becomes 63.0 cm, the other distance staying 56.0 cm. What does it detect now? (3 marks)
(2.8 cm microwave tajurbe mein probe aik gap se 56.0 cm aur doosre se 64.4 cm door hai. (i) Intensity zyada hai ya kam? (ii) Probe ko hilaya jata hai ke door wale gap se faasla 63.0 cm ho jaye aur doosra 56.0 cm hi rahe. Ab kya pakra jayega?)
blocks.explanation: Path difference ÷ λ nikalein: poora adad yani zyada intensity, aadha adad yani kam intensity.

book_ref.quote: Using 2.8 cm wavelength microwave equipment

steps: Lehrein in phase: constructive interference, zyada intensity
(ii) Path difference = 63.0 − 56.0 = 7.0 cm; 7.0/2.8 = 2.5, aadha adad: destructive interference, kam intensity

blocks.prompt:
7 Describe a simple arrangement to show interference of light using a laser and two slits. How can it be shown that light reaches the screen from both slits? Why is a laser more convenient than a bulb? (5 marks)
(Laser aur do slits se light ka interference dikhane ka saada intezam bayan karein. Kaise dikhaya ja sakta hai ke light dono slits se screen tak pohnchti hai? Laser bulb se zyada asaan kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Intezam (Fig. 15.7): Laser ki light do slits se guzari jati hai; slits kaali slide par do saaf lakeerein hain jin ka faasla millimetre ka kuch hissa hai. Dono slits ki light aage ki jagah mein milti hai.

Mushahida: Screen par barabar faasle wale roshni ke nuqton ka silsila nazar aata hai. Yeh roshan nuqte interference fringes hain, jahan dono slits ki lehrein in phase pohnchti hain (constructive interference). Darmiyan ki andheri jagahein destructive interference ka natija hain. Roshan fringes do loudspeakers ki tez awaz aur andheri fringes halki awaz ke barabar hain.

Dono slits se light: Screen par andheri fringe par nishan lagayein. Aik slit dhaanp dein taake light sirf aik slit se guzre. Fringes ghaib ho jati hain aur screen par chauri roshni ki patti aati hai; yeh single slit ka diffraction pattern hai. Jo point andhera tha ab roshan hai. Doosri slit dhaanpne par bhi yahi hota hai. Yani dono slits se light pohnchti hai, magar andheri fringes par dono beams aik doosre ko khatam karti hain.

Laser kyun: Tez bulb se bhi milte julte nataij milte hain, magar laser asaan hai kyunke us ki light tang aur zyada tez beam mein markooz hoti hai. Yeh mashhoor Young double-slit tajurba hai jo Thomas Young ne 1801 mein laser ke baghair kiya.

book_ref.quote: A simple arrangement involves directing the light from a laser through two slits

blocks.prompt:
8 In a two-slit laser experiment, light of wavelength 480 nm falls on slits 0.24 mm apart and the screen is 1.2 m away. Find the distance from the centre of the pattern to (i) the first dark fringe (m = 0) and (ii) the dark fringe for m = 2. Use the small-angle result y = L sin θ. (3 marks)
(Do-slit laser tajurbe mein 480 nm ki light 0.24 mm door slits par parti hai aur screen 1.2 m door hai. Pattern ke markaz se nikalein: (i) pehli andheri fringe (m = 0) aur (ii) m = 2 wali andheri fringe ka faasla. Chhote angle ka natija y = L sin θ istemal karein.)
blocks.explanation: Andheri fringe ki shart d sin θ = (m + ½)λ se sin θ nikalein, phir y = L sin θ.

book_ref.quote: at points for which the path difference is a half-integer number (m + ½) of wavelengths

blocks.prompt:
9 Describe Young's double slit experiment. Explain the fringes at the points A (central), B (first dark) and C (next bright), and show that the path difference at a point P on the screen is r₂ − r₁ = d sin θ. (5 marks)
(Young ka double slit tajurba bayan karein. Points A (markazi), B (pehli andheri) aur C (agli roshan) par fringes ki wazahat karein, aur dikhayein ke screen par point P par path difference r₂ − r₁ = d sin θ hai.)
blocks.explanation:
Tajurba (1801): Young ne is se light ki wave nature dikhayi. Light ki beam beam par amood do parallel slits par parti hai. Har slit se light diffract ho kar phailti hai; dono slits ki light screen par mil kar roshan aur andheri pattiyan (fringes) banati hai. Sources coherent hon (mustaqil phase difference, aik jaisi wavelength); aaj kal aik laser beam do slits se guzari jati hai (Fig. 15.8).

Point A: slits ke beech ke bilkul saamne. A dono slits se barabar door hai, path difference sifar. In phase nikli rays in phase pohnchti hain: constructive interference, roshan fringe.

Point B: thora side par; pehli andheri fringe ka beech. Slit 1 ki light slit 2 se thora zyada chalti hai. Dono rays antiphase (180°) mein hain, is liye path difference aadhi wavelength: destructive interference.

Point C: agli roshan fringe ka beech, AB = BC. Ray 1 aik poori wavelength λ zyada chalti hai. Rays in phase: constructive interference, roshan fringe. Poora pattern isi tarah samjha jata hai (Fig. 15.9).

Path difference: Farz karein ke slits se screen ka faasla L, slits ke faasle d se bohat bara hai (slits chand millimetre door, screen aik metre ya zyada). Tab S₁ aur S₂ se P tak lakeerein taqreeban parallel hain (Fig. 15.9 c). S₁ se S₂P par amood girane se S₂ wali ray ka zaid faasla aik chhote qaima zaviya tikon ka zila hai jis ka hypotenuse d aur angle θ hai:
r₂ − r₁ = d sin θ ... (15.1)
jahan θ slits se screen ki line aur slits ki satah ke normal ke darmiyan angle hai.

book_ref.quote: We will consider three points on the screen

blocks.prompt:
10 In Young's experiment the slits are 0.15 mm apart and the light has wavelength 600 nm. For the second bright fringe beside the centre (m = 2), find (i) the path difference, (ii) the angle θ, (iii) the phase relation of the two rays there. (3 marks)
(Young ke tajurbe mein slits 0.15 mm door hain aur light ki wavelength 600 nm hai. Markaz ke saath doosri roshan fringe (m = 2) ke liye nikalein: (i) path difference, (ii) angle θ, (iii) wahan dono rays ka phase talluq.)
blocks.explanation: m order ki roshan fringe ka path difference mλ hai; phir r₂ − r₁ = d sin θ se θ nikalein.

book_ref.quote: The difference in path length is then given by

steps: (iii) Path difference poore wavelengths hai, is liye rays in phase pohnchti hain (constructive interference)

blocks.prompt:
11 Write the conditions for bright and dark fringes in a two-slit experiment. Derive expressions for the position of the mth bright fringe and for the fringe spacing. How does the spacing depend on the slit separation? (5 marks)
(Do-slit tajurbe mein roshan aur andheri fringes ki sharait likhein. mth roshan fringe ki position aur fringe spacing ke formulas derive karein. Spacing slits ke faasle par kaise munhasir hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Sharait: Constructive interference (roshan) wahan jahan path difference poore wavelengths ho:
d sin θ = mλ (m = 0, 1, 2, 3, …) ... (15.2)
Destructive interference (andheri) wahan jahan path difference aadhe-adad wavelengths ho:
d sin θ = (m + ½)λ (m = 0, 1, 2, 3, …)
Pattern slits S₁ aur S₂ ke parallel roshan aur andheri pattiyon ka silsila hai.

mth roshan fringe ki position (Fig. 15.10): yₘ pattern ke markaz (θ = 0) se mth roshan band ke markaz tak faasla aur θₘ us ka angle hai. Tab
yₘ = L tan θₘ ... (15.3)
yₘ, L se bohat chhota hai, is liye θₘ bohat chhota aur sin θₘ ≈ tan θₘ. Is liye taqreeban
yₘ = L sin θₘ ... (15.4)
Eq. (15.2) se sin θₘ = mλ/d. Rakhne se:
yₘ = mLλ/d ... (15.5) (chhote angles)

Fringe spacing: (m + 1)th aur mth roshan bands ke liye
Δy = yₘ₊₁ − yₘ = (m + 1)Lλ/d − mLλ/d
Δy = Lλ/d ... (15.6)
Lagataar andheri fringes ka faasla bhi yahi hai.

d par inhisar: Δy, d ke ulat mutanasib hai. Slits jitni qareeb, pattern utna phaila hua; slits door hon to pattiyan qareeb. Yeh nataij do coherent sources ki har lehar ke liye durust hain agar d ke muqable mein door dekha jaye.

book_ref.quote: We can derive an expression for the positions of the centers of the bright bands on the screen.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Yahan sin θₘ aur tan θₘ barabar nahi, sirf chhote angle par taqreeban barabar hain. Is liye yₘ = mLλ/d aur Δy = Lλ/d taqreebi formulas hain jo markaz ke qareeb ki fringes ke liye theek kaam karte hain.

blocks.prompt:
12 Green light of wavelength 546 nm falls on two slits 0.40 mm apart; the screen is 1.6 m away. Find (i) the fringe spacing, (ii) the distance of the 5th bright fringe from the centre, (iii) the distance between the 2nd and 6th bright fringes. (3 marks)
(546 nm ki hari light 0.40 mm door do slits par parti hai; screen 1.6 m door hai. Nikalein: (i) fringe spacing, (ii) 5th roshan fringe ka markaz se faasla, (iii) 2nd aur 6th roshan fringes ka darmiyani faasla.)
blocks.explanation: Δy = Lλ/d aur yₘ = mLλ/d istemal karein; fringes barabar faasle par hain.

book_ref.quote: The distance between adjacent bright bands in the pattern is inversely proportional to the distance d

blocks.prompt:
13 Explain interference in thin films. Why do thin films show colours? Discuss the interference in an air wedge between two glass plates and explain why the line of contact is found dark. (5 marks)
(Patli films mein interference ki wazahat karein. Patli films rangeen kyun nazar aati hain? Do sheeshe ki plates ke darmiyan air wedge mein interference bayan karein aur batayein ke milne ki line andheri kyun milti hai.)
blocks.explanation:
Patli films: Paani par tairti tail ki patli teh ya sabun ke bulbule se reflect hoti light mein rangeen pattiyan nazar aati hain. t motai ki film ki upar ki satah par parne wali light kuch upar ki satah se reflect hoti hai (path abc). Upar ki satah se guzarne wali light kuch neeche ki satah se reflect hoti hai (path abdef) (Fig. 15.11). Mukhtalif path lambai wali dono reflect hui lehrein aankh ke retina par point P par mil kar phase ke mutabiq constructive ya destructive interference karti hain.

Rang: Har rang ki wavelength alag hai, is liye kuch rangon ka constructive aur kuch ka destructive interference hota hai. Rangeen patterns ki pecheeda shaklein (maslan bulbule ki deewarein, Fig. 15.12) film ki motai badalne se banti hain.

Air wedge (Fig. 15.13): Do sheeshe ki plates ke darmiyan hawa ki patli wedge hai; monochromatic light taqreeban amoodan parti hai. Wedge ke saath wali satahon se reflect hui do lehrein dekhein. Har point par path difference wedge ki motai ka dugna hai:
path difference = 2t
Sirf path difference se tawaqqo: jahan 2t poore wavelengths ho wahan roshan, aadhe-adad ho wahan andhera; jahan plates milti hain (t = 0) wahan path difference nahi, is liye roshan jagah honi chahiye.

Mushahida: Roshan aur andheri fringes banti hain magar ulat jati hain. Milne ki line par andheri fringe milti hai. Yani reflection ke dauran aik lehar mein aadhe cycle ka phase shift hota hai; milne ki line par reflect hui dono lehrein barabar path ke bawajood aadha cycle out of phase hain. Yeh phase shift Maxwell's equations aur light ki electromagnetic nature se maloom kiya ja sakta hai.

book_ref.quote: Light waves are reflected from the front and back surfaces of such thin films

blocks.prompt:
14 Light of wavelength 589 nm falls normally on an air wedge between two glass plates. (i) Find the thickness of the air at the point where 2t = 6λ. (ii) Is this point bright or dark? (iii) Find the thickness at the nearest bright fringe beyond it, where 2t = 6.5λ. (3 marks)
(589 nm ki light do sheeshe ki plates ke darmiyan air wedge par amoodan parti hai. (i) Us point par hawa ki motai nikalein jahan 2t = 6λ. (ii) Yeh point roshan hai ya andhera? (iii) Us se aage qareeb tareen roshan fringe par, jahan 2t = 6.5λ, motai nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Path difference 2t hai; aadhe cycle ke phase shift ki wajah se poore λ par andhera aur aadhe-adad par roshni.

book_ref.quote: At points where 2t is an integer number of wave lengths, we expect to see constructive interference

steps: (ii) 2t poore wavelengths hai; aadhe cycle ke phase shift se fringes ulat jati hain, is liye point andhera hai

blocks.prompt:
15 What are Newton's rings? Describe how they are formed and explain why they are circular. Give their uses. (5 marks)
(Newton's rings kya hain? Yeh kaise bante hain aur gol kyun hote hain, wazahat karein. In ke istemal likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Intezam (Fig. 15.14): Plano-convex lens ki convex satah ko flat sheeshe ki plate se mila kar rakha jata hai. Dono satahon ke darmiyan hawa ki patli film banti hai; milne ke point par motai sifar aur bahar ki taraf barhti hai.

Banna: Monochromatic source, jaise sodium lamp, ki light arrangement par parti hai. Yeh hawa ki film ki upar aur neeche dono satahon se reflect hoti hai. Dono reflect hui rays path difference aur phase shift ke mutabiq constructive (roshan rings) ya destructive (andheri rings) interference karti hain. Air wedge ki tarah path difference film ki motai ka taqreeban dugna hai aur aik ray mein aadhe cycle ka phase shift hota hai.

Gol kyun: Milne ke point se barabar faasle par, yani aik daire par, hawa ki film ki motai har jagah aik jaisi hai. Is liye har roshan ya andheri fringe milne ke point ke gird daira hai (Fig. 15.15). Yeh gol fringes Newton ne parhin, is liye Newton's rings kehlati hain.

Istemal:
(1) Monochromatic light ki wavelength nikalna.
(2) Lenses ka radius of curvature maloom karne mein madad.
(3) Precision optics mein satah ki be-qaidgiyan pakarna.

book_ref.quote: A thin film of air is formed between the two surfaces.

blocks.prompt:
16 Newton's rings are viewed by reflected sodium light of wavelength 589 nm. Treating the path difference as twice the air-film thickness t with a half-cycle phase shift (as for the air wedge), find (i) the thickness of air at the dark ring where 2t = 10λ, (ii) the change in thickness from one dark ring to the next, (iii) the thickness at the next dark ring outward. (3 marks)
(Newton's rings 589 nm ki sodium light ke reflection mein dekhe jate hain. Path difference ko hawa ki film ki motai t ka dugna aur aadhe cycle ka phase shift (air wedge ki tarah) maan kar nikalein: (i) us andheri ring par motai jahan 2t = 10λ, (ii) aik andheri ring se agli tak motai ki tabdeeli, (iii) bahar ki taraf agli andheri ring par motai.)
blocks.explanation: Andheri rings wahan jahan 2t poore wavelengths ho; agli andheri ring ke liye 2t aik λ barhna chahiye.

book_ref.quote: The reflected rays interfere-constructively (bright rings)

steps: (ii) 2t mein λ ka izafa, is liye t mein λ/2 = 294.5 nm ≈ 0.29 μm

blocks.prompt:
17 Define diffraction and a diffraction grating. Derive the grating equation d sin θ = nλ and explain the orders of the pattern. (5 marks)
(Diffraction aur diffraction grating ki definition likhein. Grating equation d sin θ = nλ derive karein aur pattern ke orders ki wazahat karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Diffraction: rukawat ke gird light ka murna aur light ki lehron ka rukawat ke geometrical saaye mein phailna.

Diffraction grating: barabar faasle wali bohat si parallel slits ki tarteeb. Saath wali slits ke markazon ka faasla d grating spacing hai; d fi unit lambai slits ki tadaad ka ulta hai. (Har slit ki chaurai alag aur chhoti miqdaar hai.) Pehli grating Fraunhofer ne bareek taaron se banayi; gratings diamond ki nok se sheeshe ya metal par barabar lakeerein khurach kar, ya photographic reduction se banti hain. Slits ko rulings ya lines bhi kehte hain.

Derivation (Fig. 15.16): Plane monochromatic lehar transmission grating par amoodan parti hai. Far-field (Fraunhofer) halaat mein screen ke aik point ki taraf jaane wali tamam rays parallel hain aur seedhe rukh se θ angle par hain. Saath wali slits ki rays ka path difference d sin θ hai. Principal maxima, do slits wali simton mein hi, wahan bante hain jahan yeh path difference poore wavelengths ho:
d sin θ = nλ, n = 0, ±1, ±2, ±3, … ... (15.7)

Orders: n = 0 markazi maximum (θ = 0) hai. n = ±1 first-order lines, n = ±2 second-order lines, waghaira (Fig. 15.17). Saikron ya hazaron slits se pattern bohat tez (sharp) lines ka silsila hai, do slits se zyada tang, is liye un ke angles aur wavelength bohat durust naapi ja sakti hai. sin θ, 1 se zyada nahi ho sakta, is liye n, d/λ se zyada nahi ho sakta.

book_ref.quote: A plane monochromatic wave is incident normally on the grating from the left side.

blocks.prompt:
18 Sodium light of wavelength 589 nm falls normally on a grating with 5000 lines per cm. Find (i) the grating spacing, (ii) the angles of the first- and second-order maxima, (iii) the highest order that can be seen. (3 marks)
(589 nm ki sodium light 5000 lines per cm wali grating par amoodan parti hai. Nikalein: (i) grating spacing, (ii) first aur second order maxima ke angles, (iii) sab se ooncha order jo dekha ja sakta hai.)
blocks.explanation: d fi unit lambai lines ka ulta hai; d sin θ = nλ lagayein, aur sab se oonche order ke liye sin θ ≤ 1.

book_ref.quote: So the positions of the maxima are once again.

19 Explain the pattern formed when a diffraction grating is illuminated (i) by monochromatic light and (ii) by white light. Why should the grating spacing be of the same order as the wavelength, and what is the usual spacing of a grating for visible light? (5 marks)
(Diffraction grating par (i) monochromatic light aur (ii) safaid light dalne se bannay wale pattern ki wazahat karein. Grating spacing wavelength ke hum-paimana kyun honi chahiye, aur nazar aane wali light ki grating ki aam spacing kya hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Monochromatic light: Saikron ya hazaron slits wali grating par parallel monochromatic light dalne se d sin θ = nλ wale angles par bohat tez lines ka silsila banta hai. n = 0 line seedhi aage; n = ±1 first-order, n = ±2 second-order lines, waghaira. Usi spacing par slits barhane se maxima usi jagah rehte hain magar tang hote jate hain (100 aur 2000 slits ki gratings ka muqabla).

Safaid light: Safaid light mein wavelengths musalsal phaili hoti hain. Har n ke liye Eq. (15.7) har wavelength ko alag angle deti hai, is liye har order aik musalsal spectrum ban jata hai. sin θ = nλ/d, is liye lambi wavelengths (laal) zyada angle par, yani seedhe rukh se zyada murti hain, aur chhoti wavelengths (neeli) kam angle par.

d ka order: Eq. (15.7) ke mutabiq murne ke angles ke sine λ/d ke mutanasib hain. Wazeh murne ke liye d, λ ke hum-paimana ho. Agar d, λ se bohat bari ho to sin θ bohat chhota aur lines markaz ke qareeb jama ho jayengi.

Aam grating: Nazar aane wali light (λ 400 se 700 nm) ke liye gratings mein taqreeban 1000 slits per millimetre hoti hain. d fi unit lambai slits ka ulta hai, is liye d = 1/1000 mm = 10⁻⁶ m, yani taqreeban 1000 nm.

21 Explain why X-rays are diffracted by crystals. Derive Bragg's equation for the diffraction of X-rays by a crystal. (5 marks)
(X-rays crystals se kyun diffract hoti hain, wazahat karein. Crystal se X-rays ke diffraction ke liye Bragg equation derive karein.)
blocks.explanation:
X-rays aur crystals: X-rays bohat chhoti wavelength, taqreeban 10⁻¹⁰ m, ki electromagnetic radiation hain. Diffraction dekhne ke liye grating spacing wavelength ke hum-paimana honi chahiye. Crystal mein atoms ki baqaida tarteeb ≈ 10⁻¹⁰ m spacing ki qudrati diffraction grating hai. Crystal lattice ke atoms se X-rays ka bikharna aam grating par nazar aane wali light jaise diffraction asraat deta hai.

Bragg ka mushahida: W.H. Bragg aur W.L. Bragg ne dekha ke monochromatic X-ray beam crystal plane se aise reflect hoti hai jaise plane aaina ho.

Derivation (Fig. 15.18): Crystal face ke parallel atomi planes PP′, P₁P′₁, P₂P′₂, … lein jin ka darmiyani faasla d mustaqil hai. X-ray beam planes par θ angle par parti hai. Yeh upar aur neeche dono planes se reflect hoti hai. Neeche wale plane se reflect hone wali beam upar wale ke muqable mein zyada chalti hai: andar aate aur bahar jaate har baar d sin θ zyada, is liye dono reflect hui beams ka moassar path difference
path difference = 2d sin θ
Taqwiyat ke liye path difference wavelength ka poora guna ho:
2d sin θ = nλ ... (15.8)
n order of reflection hai aur Eq. (15.8) Bragg equation hai. Maloom wavelength ki X-rays se crystal ki interplanar spacing nikali jati hai.

book_ref.quote: The beam can be reflected from both the upper and the lower planes of atoms.

23 Compare the diffraction of X-rays by a crystal with the diffraction of light by a grating. What are the uses of X-ray diffraction? (5 marks)
(Crystal se X-rays ke diffraction ka grating se light ke diffraction se muqabla karein. X-ray diffraction ke istemal kya hain?)
blocks.explanation:
Mushabihat: Dono mein scatterers ki baqaida tarteeb wahan maxima banati hai jahan saath wale scatterers ki lehrein mazboot hon, yani path difference poore wavelengths ho. Crystal lattice ke atoms se X-rays ka bikharna aam grating par light jaise diffraction asraat deta hai.

Farq table mein hain.

X-ray diffraction ke istemal:
(1) Crystals ke atomi dhanche ka mutala, jo W.H. Bragg aur W.L. Bragg ne shuru kiya.
(2) Maloom wavelength ki X-rays se Bragg equation crystal ke milte julte parallel planes ki interplanar spacing deti hai.
(3) Hayatiyati tor par aham molecules, jaise hemoglobin (khoon ka aham juz) aur DNA ka double helix, ka dhancha maloom karne mein bohat mufeed raha hai.
